## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The updated Hono release corrects several edge cases that can affect request handling and response safety. It now matches security-cookie prefixes without regard to case, sanitizes non-ASCII API Gateway v2 header values, escapes JSX attribute values, and applies CSP nonces to scripts generated by `ErrorBoundary`. It also fixes URL query-key matching across separators and cancels discarded response bodies. [#2154](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2154)

Systematic v3.32.2 improves the `ce:connect` research workflow: truncated results no longer prematurely stop searching, and dropped candidates are identified in its digest and run record. The update also restores patched Undici for `node-gyp` and raises the required OpenCode v2 version to the one verified by CI. [#2167](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2167)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The gateway and workspace now run exclusively on OpenCode V2. The gateway rejects runs unless workspace `/readyz` reports a valid V2 version, and the workspace agent exits with a clear error if its configured version is missing, invalid, or V1.

Workspace image builds now require `OPENCODE_VERSION` to match the repository's V2 pin; the version gate runs before downloads, so missing, V1, `latest`, and other mismatched versions fail early. V2 credentials come from the root supervisor, and deployments can roll back by redeploying the previous gateway and workspace image pair. [#2160](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2160)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

The Action now runs OpenCode V2 only. The `opencode-version` input accepts only the recorded pin (currently `2.2.6`), `latest`, or no value; unsupported versions are rejected before setup or network access, and V1 users are directed to pin the Action to `v0.137.0`.

V2 remains able to restore V1 session data through fallback restore tiers and the V1 database import wait, but the two generations do not reconcile session history after a rollback. To avoid overwriting good history with stale runner data, cache and object-store persistence is armed only after this invocation’s V2 server starts; earlier failures still run cleanup but do not save state. [#2152](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2152)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Trusted runs can now load repository skills from `.agents/skills` without enabling project configuration. Skills come fresh from the default branch, and untrusted runs cannot supply them; the Action admits only bounded, regular skill files and skips failures without failing the run. [#2142](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2142)

`/fro-bot dispatch` now applies the repository denylist before starting a credentialed workflow, refusing denied, unbound, or policy-unavailable repositories without making a GitHub call. The dispatched run targets the stored repository binding. [#2139](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2139)

Question-tool input no longer leaks into Discord replies or live activity status as raw JSON. The shared formatter suppresses question-tool lines across V1 and V2 while preserving fallback rendering for unknown and MCP tools. [#2141](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2141)

GitHub comment and review instructions now pass Markdown bodies through a quoted heredoc and `--body-file -`, avoiding shell expansion and quoting damage. The verdict flags and one-review rule are unchanged. [#2144](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2144)

The setup documentation now clarifies that withholding a credential does not isolate it from an agent running as the same Linux user: process environments may still expose it. It describes a separate-runner handoff pattern for write credentials; this is a documentation clarification, not a runtime behavior change. [#2145](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2145)

The prepare-release workflow now requests repository-scoped permissions for contents, pull requests, and workflows, and skips manual dispatches from non-default branches. [#2136](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2136)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

A PR review now stays tied to the exact commit the agent examined. If the branch advances before submission, the review is withheld rather than being attached to—and potentially approving—code the agent never reviewed; missing reviewed-head data also fails closed. [#2126](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2126)

When a Discord run fails without producing visible text, the failure reply is now posted without a preceding “(no output)” placeholder. Partial output is still delivered before the failure explanation, while the web sink retains its final output frame. [#2128](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2128)
